# Retained title capture

`xml_usc01@119-103.zip` is the exact bounded title ZIP already retained by
SpicyDocs at `tests/fixtures/uscode/xml_usc01@119-103.zip`.

Source: https://uscode.house.gov/download/releasepoints/us/pl/119/103/xml_usc01@119-103.zip

It supplies real publisher XML for archive, native edition and receipt parity
tests. Synthetic malformed archives remain in the test code; the real ZIP is
never rewritten. U.S. government source material.
